tags.gist: Finds the paper's account of confabulation, unbounded inputs and drift well supported by studies of planted false details and low diagnostic accuracy, if anything understated.
Calls the clinician-licensure analogy a reasonable organizing principle reflecting live scholarly debate.
Wants any comparator clinician panel required to report its own inter-rater reliability, such as Cohen's kappa, since panel disagreement is a known confound.
Citing hallucination and accuracy studies, wants sponsors required to disclose their specific mitigations for benchmark contamination and saturation.
Flags circularity when a supervisor shares the device's architecture; wants supervisory agents to pass the safety benchmarking elements before being credited.
Wants master files made mandatory disclosures for higher-consequence devices, since developers have little incentive to disclose limitations.
Notes no GenAI device has yet been authorized, so the framework is an untested scaffold; asks for reliability reporting, supervisor benchmarking and mandatory disclosure.
